CapBudget

Official binary mirror of the CapBudget Android app, published directly by its developer. Local-first household budgeting: no account, no server-side data, everything stays on your device.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://repo.pixeon.fr/repo
